description: Cut the n=512/1024 trailing update from 3 cuBLAS bmm launches per panel to 2 by fusing the final subtract into a GEMM epilogue. Per panel the trailing update does W=V^T C (bmm1), W=T^T W (bmm2 or trmm), C -= V W (bmm3). The GEMMs are individually optimal (cuBLAS, confirmed unbeatable) — but each is a separate launch, and the panel loop runs n/nb of them. Fuse C -= V W into bmm3 via torch.baddbmm(C, V, W, beta=1, alpha=-1) so the subtract is the GEMM epilogue (already likely done — verify), AND fold the T^T W (bmm2) into bmm1 or bmm3 where possible: e.g. precompute V·T once (or T^T into the first contraction) so the three contractions become two. This is launch-overhead/orchestration reduction, NOT replacing the GEMM kernel (custom GEMM loses, 5× confirmed). Also try issuing the W=V^T C and the next panel's independent work so the scheduler overlaps them on the DEFAULT queue (no extra stream). Measure with nsys total-GPU-time + back-to-back A/B. FP32 panel; keep n!=512/1024 as parent; no 'stream' substring incl. comments.

Fuse bmm2 into the panel (emit VT=V*T^T), 2-bmm trailing for n=512 AND n=1024. Panel kernels templated on compile-time EMIT_VT; when true they pre-multiply the block reflector VT=V*T^T in-SMEM -> VTws, so the host trailing update is W=V^T C; C-=VT@W (2 cuBLAS bmm/panel instead of 3). n=352 + n=2048/4096 cluster keep EMIT_VT=false (byte-identical). Validate PASS (22 tests + kernelguard + 3 guards CLEAN; geqrf-exact). nsys CONFIRMS the launch reduction: n=512 45->30 GEMM launches/call, n=1024 93->62 (exactly the 15/31 bmm2 removed). MEASURED NEGATIVE (raw geomean 9144.7 at LOW contention -- NOT comparable to the 131187 ref baseline run; use anchors). Contention-normalized via untouched shapes 2/5/6 (f=1.485): n=512 ~-3% (3/7/10), n=512 rankdef -17%, n=1024 -20% (4/8/11). The naive VT pass was r-major (strided P reads). Root cause: the added O(m*cb^2/2) VT work lands in the panel kernel (already 57% at n=512, 90% at n=1024) + an extra m*cb VTws HBM write/panel, costing more than the saved bmm2 launches.

Coalesced VT pass (c-major/r-minor so consecutive threads own consecutive rows r -> P read + VTb store coalesce; trial-1 was strided r-major), emit_vt ON for BOTH n=512 and n=1024. (Code = HEAD de9ceac with the n=1024 emit_vt one-liner re-enabled; the committed de9ceac is the n512-only trial 3.) Validate PASS (22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN). MEASURED: coalescing gained +1.2..+3.6% on every touched shape vs trial 1 (same low contention, anchors within 0.1%). vs baseline (normalized f=1.485): n=512 dense/clustered ~break-even (1.001), n=512 mixed -0.6%, n=512 rankdef -14.5%, n=1024 still -19% (4/8/11). Confirms the n=1024 regression is the in-panel VT work, not the access pattern. raw geomean 9023.6 at low contention.

Coalesced VT pass + emit_vt n=512 ONLY (n=1024 reverted to parent 3-bmm after measuring -20%). Validate PASS (22 tests + kernelguard + 3 guards CLEAN). DECISIVE SAME-CONTENTION A/B (re-benched the parent in the SAME low-contention window, residual anchor ratio 1.002): trial-3 vs parent = n=512 dense/clustered (3/10) -3.8%, n=512 mixed (7) -3.2%, n=512 rankdef (9) -15.2%; n=1024 (4/8/11) +0.1..+0.4% (parent-equivalent, validates the A/B). n=512 geomean -6.6%, full 12-shape geomean -2.15% (parent-now 8421 vs t3 8606). ROOT CAUSE (nsys n=512): cudaStreamSynchronize=1.76ms=86.5% of API time (the classify .item() host sync) DWARFS the ~40us saved by removing 15 bmm2 launches/call (45->30 GEMM launches confirmed); the GPU is SM-saturated at B=640 so those launches overlap GPU work and are NOT on the critical path -> removing them saves ~0, while the in-panel VT=V*T^T work (panel is 57% of n=512) + extra m*cb VTws HBM write costs 3.8-15% (worst on rankdef whose degenerate columns make the baseline panel cheaper, so the constant VT pass is a larger fraction). The baddbmm epilogue fusion (brief item 1) was ALREADY in the parent. Side-queue overlap (brief item 3) is BANNED + brief 19 confirmed single-queue overlap does not help.

Brief 46 (cut n=512/1024 trailing update 3 cuBLAS bmm/panel -> 2 by folding bmm2) BUILT, CORRECT, exhaustively measured across 3 trials -- MEASURED NEGATIVE, with a profile-confirmed root cause. MECHANISM (HEAD de9ceac): the panel kernels are templated on a compile-time bool EMIT_VT; when true they pre-multiply the block reflector VT=V*T^T in-SMEM (they already hold V in P and T) and write it to a VTws workspace, so the host trailing update drops the small W=T^T W bmm and becomes W=V^T C; C-=VT@W -- TWO cuBLAS bmm/panel instead of three. n=352 + the n=2048/4096 cluster keep EMIT_VT=false (byte-identical -- confirmed: n=1024 A/B parent-equivalent +/-0.4%). Every trial: 22 tests + kernelguard + 3 guards (diff_correctness 12x8 / invariance / offgrid) CLEAN; the 2-bmm form is the IDENTICAL V T^T V^T C contraction so (H,tau) stays geqrf-exact. nsys CONFIRMS the launch reduction worked exactly as designed: n=512 45->30 GEMM launches/call, n=1024 93->62 (the 15/31 bmm2 removed). DECISIVE same-contention A/B (parent re-benched in the same low-contention window, anchor ratio 1.002): n=512 dense/clustered -3.8%, mixed -3.2%, RANKDEF -15.2%; n=1024 parent-equivalent (so n512-only is the least-bad config, HEAD). n=512 geomean -6.6%, full -2.15%. ROOT CAUSE: at n=512 B=640 a classify .item() cudaStreamSynchronize = 1.76ms = 86.5% of API time DWARFS the ~40us of saved launch overhead, and the GPU is SM-saturated so the bmm launches already overlap GPU work (NOT on the critical path) -> removing them saves ~0; meanwhile the in-panel VT work (panel is 57% at n=512, 90% at n=1024) + an extra m*cb VTws HBM write/panel costs 3.8-20% (worst at n=1024 where the panel dominates, and on rankdef whose degenerate columns make the baseline panel cheaper so the constant VT pass is a larger fraction). Brief item 1 (baddbmm epilogue) was ALREADY in the parent. Brief item 3 (issue W=V^T C concurrent with the next panel for scheduler overlap) requires a side queue -- BANNED here -- and brief 19 already MEASURED single-queue overlap does NOT help (the panel serializes after the GEMM on one queue), so the only remote-safe overlap path is closed. STILL OPEN for the manager: (1) the real n=512 critical-path cost is the classify .item() host SYNC (1.76ms), not launch count -- a SYNC-FREE device-flag classify (briefs 27/36 territory) is the lever that would actually shorten n=512, orthogonal to bmm count; (2) a cheaper VT would only reach break-even at n=512 (launch saving ~0 on the critical path), so the VT-in-panel direction has no positive ceiling here and I did not pursue it further; (3) the launch-count lever would only pay on a NON-saturated, NON-panel-dominated shape that uses the cuBLAS trailing -- none of the in-scope n=512/1024 shapes qualify (n=512 saturates SMs, n=1024 is panel-bound), so this orchestration lever appears mismatched to the current bottleneck structure.
